Gift ideas to explore

For their next flight

Flight Gear Stealth Bag

$79.95

A flight bag is a gift they can use beyond the holidays. This compact backpack-style option is worth a look when their current setup is an overflowing ordinary bag.

Buying tips

Compare the listed dimensions with their headset, tablet and usual load before choosing.

A useful little extra

Flight Gear Aviator’s Light

$29.95

A compact light with separate red and white controls. It makes sense for the person who likes keeping small, useful tools in their flight bag.

Buying tips

Ask what light they already carry; this is an accessory, not a replacement for required equipment.

For the organized pilot

Flight Gear rotating kneeboard

$22.95

A practical way to keep a compatible iPad in reach. It is most useful when you already know the pilot wants a kneeboard rather than a mounted tablet.

Buying tips

Confirm the exact iPad model, case and preferred cockpit setup with the retailer.

View at Sporty’s ↗
Under $25

SKILCRAFT B3 Aviator pen

$24.50

Black ink, red ink and a pencil in one everyday tool. An uncomplicated addition to a practical gift bundle, especially with a handwritten note.

Buying tips

Check whether they prefer paper notes; an all-digital pilot may get less use from it.
